text:
Jules (People Ops): FYI Micah is starting Mon but is currently overseas and only has an international driver's license + passport. Background intake flagged a doc country mismatch. Need I-9 plan + laptop courier + benefits timing.
Micah Patel (new hire): Hi team! I can get an embassy-certified copy tomorrow and have a cousin in SF who can act as an authorized rep. Prefer not to delay. Also curious about benefits enrollment deadlines.
Andre (Hiring Ops): Authorized rep sounds fine if Micah provides the rep waiver + rep ID. Can Micah upload the cousin's photo ID and signed attestation?
Micah Patel (new hire): Yes — cousin's name is Rohan Patel, SF number DM'd. I'll upload rep waiver and Rohan's ID tonight.
Kara (Backgrounds): Background system flagged diacritics on the passport country field which caused the fuzzy match. Manual review will be required after you upload the high-res scan + rep docs. Expect ~4 business hours once docs arrive.
IT-KitBot: For equipment: Micah requested a laptop + headset + standing desk riser. Shipping preference? If authorized rep picks up at office we can hold-for-pickup, otherwise direct to friend's address.
Micah Patel (new hire): Friend pick-up at 200 Townsend is best — I'll pick up Tuesday evening. Please require photo ID at pickup.
IT-KitBot: Shipping command used: ```label --to "Micah Patel (hold)" --addr "200 Townsend St, San Francisco, CA 94107" --carrier FedEx --hold_for_pickup --signature_required --note "ID check at pickup"``` We'll image with default profile; no admin until clearance.
Samir (Security): Security policy: VPN and admin withheld until People Ops marks i9_cleared and backgrounds_soft_clear is true. We can enable a limited sandbox group for day-1 tasks. Also need copy of rep ID and rep waiver on file.
BadgeBot: Creating a 72-hour pickup pass for micah.patel@redwood.com once shipping manifest is confirmed.
Andre (Hiring Ops): Micah  quick benefits note: enroll within 30 days of start. Payroll needs SSN for tax mapping. If SSN pending, we can provisionally enroll but mark payroll "SSN pending".
Payroll: Confirmed. You can complete benefits forms now; payroll will create a provisional tax placeholder until SSN is provided. Update payroll once you have SSN.
Micah Patel (new hire): Uploaded embassy-certified passport scan, rep waiver signed by Rohan, and Rohan's ID photo. Also attached a utility bill for the shipping address.
Kara (Backgrounds): Received uploads; starting manual review now. ETA ~3 hours. If everything matches we'll soft-clear background and set i9_status = pending_verification.
Jules (People Ops): Day-1 schedule for Micah (remote): 9:00am PT welcome, 9:30 benefits walkthrough, 10:15 IT provisioning check, 11:00 manager intro. Micah confirm you'll join 9am PT?
Micah Patel (new hire): Yes 9am PT works. Thanks everyone.
Kara (Backgrounds): Manual review complete  identity verified via passport + rep attestation + rep ID. Background = soft-cleared. I'll mark i9_pending_verification for People Ops to confirm rep packet.
Jules (People Ops): Verified rep packet & uploaded to HR system. Setting tracker flags: i9_pending=true, bg_soft_cleared=true, laptop_hold_for_pickup=true. Samir, please hold VPN until we flip final clear.
Samir (Security): Copy. We'll enable limited sandbox group for Micah and hold VPN/admin.
IT-KitBot: Laptop imaged and manifested to FedEx hold-for-pickup at 200 Townsend. ETA hub arrival tomorrow morning. BadgeBot will send QR when manifest completes.
BadgeBot: Pickup pass created for micah.patel@redwood.com  valid 72 hours after package arrival  QR emailed.
Jules (People Ops): Closing loop - action items: Micah upload SSN when available, Payroll to finalize tax once SSN arrives, IT to release full access after People Ops flips i9_cleared, Backgrounds to re-run final check post-SSN if needed. Welcome Micah! :tada:
